, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread or mistyped the release year of Les Résultats du féminisme as 2006 instead of 1906, despite the WebSurfer providing sources showing 1906. This century error led to the incorrect conclusion that Out of the Rain (1991/1992) was earlier, when in fact Les Résultats du féminisme (1906) came out earlier.
